title_en: Navratri Message - Ego of the Feeling of Surrender
body_hi:
सभी पुण्यआत्माओ को मेरा नमस्कार ___
नवरात्री के पावनपर्व होने वाले श्री मंगलमुर्ती के प्राणप्रतिष्ठा अनुष्ठान का आज पांचवा दिन था,
आज के अनुष्ठान में उत्तर दिशा का आव्हान कर उस दिशा की उर्जा को श्री मंगलमुर्ती के साथ जोडा गया आज का अनुष्ठान सुबह ८।। से २।। बजे तक चला।
जैसे जैसे अनुष्ठान आगे बदऱहा है, वैसे वैसे गर्भगृह से बाहर आना कठीण हो रहा है।
आप सभी को खुब खुब आशिर्वाद।
body_en:
My Salutations to all Pious Souls...

Now, of late sadhaks have started the trend of exhibiting how much 'feeling/sense of surrender' they have towards their 'Guru', and along with that they also repeatedly use words like 'vibrations' and 'catches' as if their spiritual state has become very good – their state is like that of 'empty vessels make the most noise'.

In reality, the sadhak who has completely surrendered certainly becomes like 'the exact replication/facsimile of the Guru', isn't it? But it is not like that. In reality, those whose sense of surrender is complete, they neither tell anyone about it, nor do they themselves know about it either.

Lots of Blessings to all of you.

Your own
Baba Swami
26|9|2025
Madhya Bharat Dhyanasthali
Butibori (Umreth Road)
Nagpur
